decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The release note alone is vague [ev-87995aee2ded], but the linked PR fills the gap. It says cert-manager used to pick the signature algorithm from a hard-coded mapping based on key algorithm and size, and now lets users choose one through a new `signatureAlgorithm` field, e.g. `SHA256WithRSA` [ev-7967909f7436][ev-b097e50b8371]. It also says the field is opt-in, and omitting it keeps the existing default mapping [ev-b097e50b8371]. The changed files (deploy/crds/crd-certificates.yaml, pkg/apis/certmanager/v1/types_certificate.go, pkg/util/pki/csr.go) show it is a new field on the Certificate CRD [ev-aa9242d349fc]. That supports subject = Certificate CRD field signatureAlgorithm, change = added, and applicability limited to Certificates that set it; confidence is low only because the truncated YAML example does not show the field's full nesting path.
